title: Fashion E-commerce Website Template
description: A comprehensive Fashion E-commerce website template by StarDesign with 17+ pages and 10.1k users. Designed specifically for women's clothing and fashion businesses, this template provides a full online store experience. Pages include landing page with featured collections, navigation bar with announcement bar, about page, store listing with product grid, product detail page with images and descriptions, search with auto-complete, filter and sorting controls, quick view product popup, shopping bag/cart page, blog post listing and detail pages, CRM promotion popup, and FAQ page. Features a vibrant, trend-forward design with sophisticated layouts to elevate brand visibility. Built with Figma components, auto-layout for responsive behavior, and a full color and text style system for consistent branding. Mobile-friendly across all screen sizes. The color palette uses warm fashion-industry tones. Product cards feature thumbnail images, name, price, rating stars, and add-to-cart buttons. Cart flow includes quantity controls, size selectors, and checkout CTA. The template covers the complete e-commerce user journey from discovery to purchase.
primary_use_case: Ideal for fashion and clothing e-commerce businesses needing a complete online store with product catalog, cart, blog, and FAQ pages ready to customize.
style_vibe: Fashion-forward e-commerce aesthetic with warm neutral tones, serif typography, and sophisticated layouts designed for women's clothing brands.
